Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call earlier. To get Ventral set up in our vendor master so Finance and Procurement can route POs and process invoices, please fill out the attached onboarding packet and return the documents below: 

- Completed vendor intake form (legal name, entity type, registered address)
- Signed W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form
- Remittance contact and preferred invoice submission channel (email/portal)
- ACH/voided check (if opting for electronic payment)

Note on PO gating: our standard practice is to require a Purchase Order for any order > $1,000. If you have orders that may exceed that threshold, confirm the PO routing contact so we can whitelist.

I’ve attached the vendor packet template for convenience. If you’d prefer to upload docs to a secure link, let me know and I’ll send a DocuSign/secure upload.

Thanks — looking forward to your materials.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of quick checks before I move this to Finance intake:

- Tax ID format looks good, but we need a digitally signed W-9 (or DocuSign envelope) for our records. The scanned PDF is acceptable if it contains an original signature; otherwise please e-sign via DocuSign.
- Confirm your AP portal submission address/URL so we can include it on the vendor record (you mentioned an AP portal — can you share the portal URL or the user invite contact?).
- Can you confirm whether Ventral requires PO numbers on all invoices or only on invoices > $1,000? We'll set the vendor master accordingly.

Once those 3 items are confirmed, I’ll create the vendor master record and return the vendor ID. Expect a brief validation step from our Compliance team (identity + sanction screen) — that usually takes 24 hours.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Finance Operations — Vendor Onboarding
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Hi Markus / Sofia,

Quick answers: 

- The W-9 attached is signed by our CFO; I've also initiated a DocuSign envelope and the link is here: https://docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d — you should see it completed within a few minutes.
- AP portal URL: https://ap.ventral-systems.com (invoices can be uploaded by vendors; if you want an account created for Redwood, we can provision one — please send the contact name/email).
- We require PO numbers on invoices that exceed $1,000; for recurring subscriptions under that amount we typically accept invoice-only processing.

Let me know if you need the CFO to re-sign anything with a different name format.

Best,
Elena
